dedupe_keys.name: data set balanced magnetic antenna for partial discharge measurements in gas insulated substations

description: TU Delft publishes an Excel dataset supporting comparisons of magnetic-loop antennas for partial-discharge sensing in gas-insulated substations. The January 2023 Zenodo record is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0 and links the describing conference paper. Workbook headers correspond to the paper’s figures and legends. The authors compare balanced and unbalanced shielded loops in a matched test bench with a fast-pulse calibrator, examining frequency response, charge estimation and common-mode noise rejection. These data can calibrate diagnostic-sensor models within substation condition-monitoring simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this benchmark. The study concerns laboratory sensor behaviour, not a fleet of operating substations or observed failure probabilities. Exact acquisition dates, sampling intervals, sheet units and measurement uncertainties remain unknown from the public summary. The workbook was not opened, and reported gain improvements were not independently assessed.
